app.name: CuraNode-AI
app.tagline: One record, shared only with the clinicians you choose.
app.encrypted_note: Records are encrypted · access is logged
auth.login.title: Welcome back
auth.login.subtitle: Sign in to your CuraNode-AI health record.
auth.login.subtitle_patient: Sign in to view and share your health record.
auth.login.subtitle_doctor: Sign in to reach your patients and today's clinic.
auth.register.title: Create your account
auth.register.subtitle: One record, shared only with the clinicians you choose.
auth.register.consent: I agree to the consent & data-handling policy.
field.pmdc_help: Recorded for your clinic to verify. Not checked against any registry.
doctor.pending_body: Your account is awaiting verification by {clinic}. You'll be able to access patient records once verified.
patient.dashboard.title: Your health record
doctor.dashboard.title: Today's clinic
admin.dashboard.title: Clinic administration
dashboard.placeholder: This area arrives with a later feature. Authentication and role-based access are in place.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.validation_failed: Please check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: That email and password combination is not correct.
errors.forbidden: Your account does not have access to this area.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.consent_required: You must accept the policy to continue.
errors.doctor_fields_required: PMDC number, specialty and clinic are all required.
errors.clinic_unknown: Select a clinic from the list.
errors.role_mismatch: This account is not registered as a {selected}. Change the selection above and try again.
auth.onboarding.title: One more step
auth.onboarding.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself to finish setting up your account.
errors.oauth_failed: We couldn't complete sign-in with Google. Please try again.
errors.oauth_unavailable: Sign-in with Google isn't available right now.
errors.oauth_email_conflict: An account with this email already exists. Sign in with your password instead.
profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Keep your details up to date. Only doctors you give access to can see them.
profile.self_reported_note: Details you add here are self-reported and are labelled that way for your doctors.
profile.no_advice_note: CuraNode does not check medicines or give medical advice. Ask your doctor before changing any treatment.
profile.remove_hint: Removed entries stay in your record history but are no longer shown.
field.emergency_contact_help: Name and phone number of a family member or friend
field.email_readonly_help: Your sign-in email can't be changed here.
errors.not_editable: This entry was recorded by a clinician and can't be changed here.
errors.duplicate_entry: This is already on your list.
errors.list_full: You can list up to {max} entries here.
errors.date_in_future: Date can't be in the future.
errors.date_before_birth: Date can't be before your date of birth.
errors.phone_invalid: Enter a Pakistani mobile number like +923001234567.
documents.title: Medical documents
documents.subtitle: Upload a prescription, lab report or vaccination record. Nothing is saved to your record until you review it and confirm.
documents.upload.title: Upload medical document
documents.upload.choose_type: What kind of document is it?
documents.upload.drop_title: Drop a file here, or choose one
documents.upload.drop_hint: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to {max} MB
documents.upload.printed_only: Printed documents only — handwritten documents are not read.
documents.upload.processing_hint: This usually takes under 30 seconds. Please keep this page open.
documents.filter.title: Search and filter documents
documents.filter.date_help: Uses the date on the document, or the day you uploaded it if it has none.
documents.filter.ignored: Some filters were not valid and were left out:
documents.filter.range_invalid: The “from” date must not be after the “to” date.
documents.empty.filtered_hint: Try fewer words, or clear the filters to see everything.
documents.pager.label: Pages of documents
documents.pager.more_in_progress: Showing the {count} newest of {total} uploads in progress. Use the filters to find the rest.
documents.quality.title: This photo may be hard to read
documents.quality.lead: Some values may be wrong or missing. For the best result, please upload a clearer photo or scan of the page.
documents.quality.issue.low_resolution: The image is small, so the text is low resolution.
documents.quality.tip.blurry: Hold the phone steady, tap the screen to focus, and keep the page flat.
documents.quality.tip.faint: Use bright, even light and avoid shadows, or scan the page instead.
documents.quality.tip.low_resolution: Take the photo at full quality, or scan the page, rather than using a small copy.
documents.quality.tip.blank: Check that the printed side of the page was photographed.
documents.quality.keep_going: You can still review and correct the values below before saving.
documents.delete.title: Delete this document?
documents.delete.body_saved: This is a saved record. Deleting it removes the original file and the details saved from it, and it can't be undone.
documents.delete.body_unsaved: This upload hasn't been saved to your record yet. Deleting it removes the file and anything read from it.
documents.delete.profile_note: Anything you already added to your profile from this document, such as an allergy, stays in your profile. Remove it there if you want it gone.
documents.delete.checkbox: I understand this can't be undone.
documents.delete.audit_note: Your account's activity log keeps a note that you deleted it (no document content).
errors.file_unavailable: We can't reach your stored files right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.service_unavailable: We can't reach the database right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unavailable.title: This page couldn't load
errors.unavailable.unsure: Your last action may not have gone through. Please go back, check, and try again.
errors.document_delete_failed: We couldn't finish deleting this document, so it has not been deleted. Please try again.
errors.document_not_deletable: This document can't be deleted from your account.
errors.delete_confirm_required: Tick the box to confirm you want to delete this record.
documents.saved.title: Saved to your record
documents.saved.body: Your reviewed details are now part of your medical record.
documents.notice.cancelled: The upload was discarded. Nothing was saved.
documents.detail.title: Medical document
documents.review.heading: Extracted fields — review before saving
documents.review.notice: Nothing enters your record until you verify it.
documents.review.ai_note: These values were read automatically and may contain mistakes. Check each one against your original document and correct anything that is wrong.
documents.review.add_hint: Missed something? Fill in the empty row to add it.
documents.review.no_fields: No individual details are extracted for this type of document. The text read from your document is kept with it.
documents.review.date_help: The date written on the document, if it has one — not the day you uploaded it.
documents.preprocess.title: Preprocessing report
documents.preprocess.lead: This is what the reader actually receives: your upload after it has been turned upright, converted to greyscale and enlarged if it was small. It is not the recognised text yet. If a read looks wrong, check here first: a blank, faint or tiny page explains most of it.
documents.preprocess.nothing_unusual: Nothing unusual found on this page.
documents.preprocess.failed: This file could not be prepared
documents.preprocess.preview_alt: Page {n} as the reader receives it
documents.preprocess.note.upscaled: The image was small, so it was enlarged {factor}x to help the reader.
documents.preprocess.note.exif_rotated: The photo's rotation setting was applied so the page is upright.
documents.preprocess.note.low_contrast: Low contrast: faint writing may be missed.
documents.preprocess.note.near_pixel_cap: Very large image, close to the size limit.
documents.processing.title: Reading your document…
documents.processing.hint: This page updates by itself. You can also check again in a moment.
documents.uploaded.title: Uploaded, not read yet
documents.uploaded.hint: Your file is stored safely but hasn't been read yet.
documents.failed.title: We couldn't read this document
documents.cancelled.title: This upload was discarded
documents.review.add_more: Add details the reader did not find
documents.group.allergies.hint: Allergies you keep here are added to your profile's allergy list when you save. Remove anything that is not an allergy; leave the table empty if there are none.
documents.saved.allergies_added: Added to your profile's allergy list: {count}.
documents.saved.allergies_skipped: Not added (already on your list, or the list is full): {count}.
documents.flag.check_hint: this may have lost a decimal point in the scan — compare it with your report
documents.review.details_heading: Other details found in your document
documents.review.details_hint: Shown so you can check them against the original. They are not editable here.
errors.document_type_invalid: Choose what kind of document this is.
errors.file_type_unsupported: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files can be uploaded.
errors.file_too_large: That file is too large. The limit is {max_mb} MB.
errors.upload_failed: We couldn't store your file. Please try again.
errors.document_state: That action isn't available for this document.
errors.document_processing: This document is already being read. Check again in a moment.
errors.ocr_unavailable: Automatic reading isn't available right now. Please try again later.
errors.ocr_failed: We couldn't read this document. Try again, or upload a clearer photo or scan.
errors.ocr_empty: No readable text was found in this document. Only printed documents can be read, so upload a clearer, well-lit photo or a higher-quality scan of a printed page.
errors.storage_failed: We couldn't open your stored file. Please try again.
errors.extraction_failed: We read the document but couldn't pick out its details. Please try again.
errors.document_rows_required: Add at least one item before saving.
errors.document_row_incomplete: Each row needs its main field filled in (the medicine or test name).
errors.value_too_long: One of the values is too long (255 characters at most).
errors.ocr_too_long: This document is too long to read automatically. Upload only the pages that matter.
errors.ocr_model_unavailable: This document was read with a handwriting reader that is no longer offered. Press Try again to read it as a printed document.
